workspaceSnapshots.title: Snapshots
workspaceSnapshots.environmentUnavailable: Environment unavailable. Saving and restoring are disabled.
workspaceSnapshots.switchPending: The workspace switch is unconfirmed. Check the original operation.
workspaceSnapshots.filesUnavailable: Saving and restoring are unavailable. History is still accessible.
workspaceSnapshots.notReceived: No original receipt was found yet. Check again or manually retry the same request.
workspaceSnapshots.switchUnavailable: Switching is currently unavailable. Finish execution and close IDE, terminal and preview connections, then refresh.
workspaceSnapshots.switchConfirm: Switch to the selected workspace? The current workspace will be kept.

errors.request: The request could not complete. Check its original status before retrying.
errors.storage: The local request could not be saved, so no new operation was sent. Restore browser storage and retry.
errors.notFound: No record accessible to your current account was found.
errors.forbidden: Your current account cannot operate on this workspace.
errors.changed: The workspace or operation conditions changed. Check the original request, then refresh.
errors.unsupported: This environment does not currently support the operation. History remains readable.

workspaceSnapshots.checkpointUnknown: Check this node’s original task and keep its workspace.

checkpointReasons.workspace_operations_disabled: Node file snapshots are disabled for this deployment. Chat and execution history remain available.
checkpointReasons.workspace_source_unavailable: The node workspace is currently unavailable. Its files are retained.
checkpointReasons.workspace_actor_unavailable: Execution authorization needs checking. The original workspace is retained.
checkpointReasons.binding_unavailable: The workspace state is unconfirmed. Keep its environment and check the original task.
checkpointReasons.capture_admission_unconfirmed: The file-save request is unconfirmed. Check the original task.
checkpointReasons.snapshot_unknown: The file-save result is unconfirmed. Check the original operation.
checkpointReasons.snapshot_failed: Files could not be saved. The original workspace is retained; check its task.
checkpointReasons.snapshot_cancelled: File saving was cancelled. The original workspace is retained.
checkpointReasons.snapshot_expired: The file-save request expired. Check the original task.
checkpointReasons.outcome_sealing_failed: The node result could not be fully saved. Check the original task.
checkpointReasons.provider_outcome_unconfirmed: The node execution result is unconfirmed. Keep its workspace and check the original task.

runSave.savingBody: “{node}” finished. Its workspace files are being saved; the run continues automatically afterwards.
runSave.failedBody: “{node}” finished, but its workspace files were not saved, so the run stopped here. The node result and sandbox are kept. Retry save only saves again and does not re-run this node.
runSave.noAction: This case cannot be retried automatically. You can delete this run, or use Retry failure in the header to re-run the stuck node.
runSave.noActionUnsealed: The node result is not confirmed yet, so it cannot be re-run. You can still delete this run.

reasons.snapshot_unknown: The save result is unconfirmed; you can check it once.
reasons.binding_unavailable: The node workspace is no longer available.
reasons.capture_admission_unconfirmed: The save request was not confirmed.
reasons.provider_outcome_unconfirmed: The node execution result is unconfirmed.

details.git_unsupported: Cause: the repository has Git metadata that cannot be saved safely.
details.workspace_limit: Cause: the workspace files exceed the save limit.
details.workspace_changed: Cause: workspace files kept changing during the save.
details.workspace_unsafe: Cause: the workspace contains unsafe paths or links.
details.workspace_integrity: Cause: the saved files failed verification.
details.job_deadline_expired: Cause: the save job could not start in time.
details.execution_owner_expired: Cause: the sandbox running the save stopped responding.
